gaps: No published K13D2U/K13C2U/YS-90A tube or strut axial compression test found (dimensions, layup, failure stress); searches returned only generic CFRP tube crush/buckling papers.
No XN-80/XN-90, P-75, P-100, P-120 composite compressive strength found in extractable text (NASA NTRS searches returned none).
No quasi-isotropic or multidirectional laminate compressive strength for pitch or M-series fibres, and no thin-ply/spread-tow compression data, found.
T700S and T1100G Toray data sheet PDFs could not be downloaded (server returned HTML); web-search summaries gave 1,450 MPa (T700S) and 1,870 MPa (T1100G) but no verified quote, so no rows.
No Weibull modulus for composite longitudinal compressive strength found; only CV values (K63712 5.1 pct, n=6; an IM-fibre NCAMP UD 5.2 pct) and CMH-17 statement of minimum 6 pct CV.
Dialead and NGF sheets print no test standard for compression and no printed year; Toray composite values are lot averages for reference only.
